name: output-noise
description: Output-referred voltage noise of bandgap_top: 0.1-10 Hz integrated noise (uVrms) against the open A6 band, plus 1 kHz/10 kHz/100 kHz spot noise density (nV/sqrt(Hz)) reference columns.
claim: README.md 'Target specification (RATIFIED 2026-07-31)' -> row 'Output noise' (amendment A6): band is defined -- 0.1-10 Hz integrated, uVrms -- but the numeric threshold is an explicit open item ('threshold TBD; add a spot-noise point if a later wave feeds an ADC'). This bench produces the measurement A6's eventual decision record needs; it does not itself claim a pass/fail threshold, and sim/suite/spec.py's NOT_CLAIMED_HERE list keeps 'Output noise' unclaimed for exactly that reason. Convention: two noise analyses per corner, both with vsup (vdd) as the required nonzero-AC input source and vref as the output. The first, `noise v(vref) vsup dec 20 0.1 10`, integrates onoise_spectrum over exactly the 0.1-10 Hz band A6 names; ngspice's onoise_total is a mean-square (V^2) quantity, so the record reports its square root as uVrms. The second, `noise v(vref) vsup dec 20 0.1 100k`, is read only at the 1 kHz/10 kHz/100 kHz decade-boundary indices (the spot-noise point A6 anticipates), converting the V^2/Hz density to V/sqrt(Hz) via sqrt() and then to nV via *1e9. Load condition: unloaded, exactly as sim/psrr-dc/ -- the ratified row's load condition is open item A4, to be fixed with the output stage (#10). Caveat until #10 lands: bandgap_amp is #8's provisional 5T OTA (design/bandgap_operating_point.md 4.1, 4.3), so these figures are a statement about provisional sizing, not the final amp's noise floor.

onoise_int_0p1_10hz_uvrms.description: No threshold: A6 (README.md) leaves the numeric limit open pending this evidence -- this is the reference measurement, not a claim. The spread floor proves the .temp/.lib corner sections actually change the noise figure (thermal noise scales with absolute temperature, flicker noise with the process corner's device parameters) rather than the sweep having silently gone flat.

f_band_lo_hz.description: Not a spec check -- asserts index 0 of the 0.1-10 Hz sweep really is 0.1 Hz, so the integration band the record names is the band ngspice actually used.

f_band_hi_hz.description: Not a spec check -- asserts index 40 of the 0.1-10 Hz sweep really is the 10 Hz band edge (2 decades at dec 20 from a 0.1 Hz start).

f_spot_1khz_hz.description: Not a spec check -- asserts the index used for the 1 kHz spot-density column really is 1 kHz (same dec 20 / 0.1 Hz start indexing sim/psrr-dc/ uses).

f_spot_10khz_hz.description: Not a spec check -- asserts the index used for the 10 kHz spot-density column really is 10 kHz.

f_spot_100khz_hz.description: Not a spec check -- asserts the index used for the 100 kHz spot-density column really is 100 kHz.

vref_op.description: Not a spec check -- accuracy is claimed in sim/output-voltage-tc/. This wide window only asserts the noise analysis linearized around the intended operating point; a corner outside it makes its noise figures uninterpretable.
